rows.name: Allying
rows.description: Allows transfer of some or all of its enhancement bonus to an ally's weapon.

rows.name: Conductive
rows.description: Conducts touch attacks from spell-like and supernatural abilities.

rows.name: Corrosive
rows.description: +1d6 acid damage

rows.name: Corrosive Burst
rows.description: A corrosive burst weapon functions as a corrosive weapon that explodes with acid upon striking a successful critical hit. The acid does not harm the wielder. In addition to the extra acid damage from the corrosive ability, a corrosive burst weapon deals an extra 1d10 points of acid damage on a successful critical hit. If the weapon's critical modifier is x3, add an extra 2d10 points of acid damage instead, and if the modifier is x4, add an extra 3d10 points. Even if the corrosive ability is not active, the weapon still deals its extra acid damage on a successful critical hit.

rows.name: Cunning
rows.description: +2 on critical confirmation rolls; requires 5 or more ranks in Knowledge skill appropriate to target

rows.name: Dueling
rows.description: +4 on initiative checks when in hand, +2 on disarm and feint checks, +2 to CMD to resist disarm, +2 to DC to feint against the wielder

rows.name: Furious
rows.description: +2 to enhancement bonus when raging, always applies its enhancement bonus to skills which are enhanced by rage powers

rows.name: Grayflame
rows.description: +1 to enhancement bonus, +1d6 holy/unholy damage, counts as good/silver or evil/cold iron, when infused with channeled energy

rows.name: Huntsman
rows.description: +1d6 damage to creatures tracked with Survival, provides enhancement bonus to track creatures the weapon has damaged

rows.name: Jurist
rows.description: +1 to +3 enhancement bonus to Perception checks and CMD when using judgement class ability

rows.name: Menacing
rows.description: +2 to flanking bonus for allies while wielder is adjacent to flanked creature

rows.name: Transformative
rows.description: On command, alters its shape to become any other melee weapon of the same general shape and handedness.

rows.name: Champion
rows.description: +2 sacred bonus to AC against attacks from the chosen opponent.

rows.name: Dastard
rows.description: +2 profane bonus to AC against attacks from the chosen opponent.

rows.name: Determination
rows.description: Once per day, when the owner reaches 0 or fewer hit points, the item automatically provides a breath of life spell.

rows.name: Jousting
rows.description: +5 competence bonus on Ride skill checks.

rows.name: Righteous
rows.description: On command once per day can invoke an effect as per the spell righteous might.

rows.name: Unrighteous
rows.description: On command once per day can invoke an effect as per the spell righteous might.
